benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against accidental damage, theft, or loss for 90 days from purchase.
benefits.terms: Up to $10,000 per occurrence, up to $50,000 per card member account per calendar year.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Refund for eligible items the retailer won't accept for return within 90 days of purchase.
benefits.terms: Up to $300 per item, up to $1,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.
benefits.terms: Up to $50,000 in coverage. Secondary coverage (not primary). Requires reserving and paying for the entire rental with this card and declining the rental company's collision damage waiver.

earningRates.terms: Flat 1.5% cash back on all eligible purchases, no categories, no cap.
